title: C++ named requirements: ScalarType
summary: Note: the standard doesn't define a named requirement with this name. This is a type category defined by the core language.
html:
Note: the standard doesn't define a named requirement with this name. This is a type category defined by the core language. It is included here as a named requirement only for consistency.

Requirements

The following types are collectively called scalar types:

  • arithmetic types
  • enumeration types
  • pointer types
  • pointer-to-member types
  • std::nullptr_t
(since C++11)
  • cv-qualified versions of these types

See also

is_scalar
(C++11)
 checks if a type is a scalar type
(class template)
